entry_contract: Continue from 12 Deeprun Tram, or select this chapter on a partially completed character. Begin in Azuremyst Isle with Technician Zhanaa. Leave at least two quest-log slots open.

steps.instruction: Travel from Teldrassil to Azuremyst Isle: Take the ship between Auberdine and Valnaar's Berth outside the Exodar. Continue to [G79.42,51.23 Azuremyst Isle]. [O]
Before you begin: travel to Azuremyst Isle and meet the first quest giver at [G79.42,51.23 Azuremyst Isle]. Leave at least two quest-log slots open. [O]
